skill.name: infsh-cli
skill.description: Use the inference.sh CLI to discover, run, and monitor cloud AI apps for images, video, LLMs, search, audio, 3D, and automation.
skill.summary: Run inference.sh cloud AI apps from the terminal with app discovery, input generation, local uploads, and task tracking.
skill.author: inferen-sh

security_audit.summary: The skill appears to be legitimate documentation for the inference.sh CLI, with no prompt injection or malicious override language found. Confirmed risks include remote pipe-to-shell installation, downloading binaries into the user PATH, automatic local file uploads to cloud services, and social media actions with external side effects.

remediation.issue: Remote pipe-to-shell installation is the primary install path.
remediation.suggestion: Make verified manual installation the default and remove direct pipe-to-shell commands from quick-start sections.

remediation.issue: Manual install moves a downloaded binary into the user PATH.
remediation.suggestion: Require checksum and signature verification before moving binaries, and show the exact target path before installation.

remediation.issue: Local paths are automatically uploaded to cloud apps.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit warnings and require confirmation before uploading local files, especially absolute paths and parent-directory paths.

remediation.issue: Twitter/X actions can publish or change account state.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before posts, direct messages, follows, likes, or retweets are run.

remediation.issue: API key setup is documented but secret-handling guidance is limited.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend secret managers, avoid pasting keys into prompts, and include key rotation guidance.

content.value_statement: Running many AI models usually requires separate APIs and setup. This skill helps agents discover and run inference.sh apps from one CLI.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation, login, API key setup, and CLI update commands.
Discovers inference.sh apps by category, search term, featured status, and newest results.
Runs cloud AI apps with inline input or saved input files.
Shows workflows for image, video, audio, LLM, search, 3D, and Twitter/X apps.
Uploads local media paths when supported by an app input.
Tracks long-running tasks and saves task results to files.
limitations: Requires an inference.sh account and a working infsh CLI installation.
Cloud app usage may consume credits or depend on provider availability.
Local files can be uploaded to cloud services when used as inputs.
Does not verify every third-party app, model output, or social posting result.

use_cases.title: Prototype AI Media Workflows
use_cases.description: Generate images, videos, audio, and 3D assets from terminal-driven prompts and saved inputs.

use_cases.title: Compare Hosted AI Apps
use_cases.description: Search the inference.sh catalog, inspect app details, and run sample inputs before choosing a model.

use_cases.title: Automate Long-Running Jobs
use_cases.description: Submit cloud tasks, return immediately, check status later, and save results for pipelines.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the infsh CLI skill to find image generation apps for product mockups. List strong options and explain when to use each one.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Sample Job
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me run a sample inference.sh video app. Generate a sample input, explain the fields, and run it after I confirm.

prompt_templates.title: Use Local Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an inference.sh workflow that uses my local image as input. Ask before uploading any file and show which path will be used.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Async Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an infsh workflow for a long-running model task. Submit without waiting, track the task, and save the result for later processing.

output_examples.input: Find a fast image generation app for concept art.
output_examples.output: The assistant lists relevant image apps, compares quality and speed, then suggests one app to inspect first.

output_examples.input: Run a video job and let me check it later.
output_examples.output: The assistant prepares input, asks for confirmation, submits the task without waiting, and records the task identifier.

output_examples.input: Use a local image for an avatar video.
output_examples.output: The assistant identifies required media paths, warns that files will upload, and waits for approval before running the app.

best_practices: Inspect app details and sample input before running a new model.
Confirm every local file path before uploading media to cloud services.
Use API keys from a secret manager and rotate them after shared sessions.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers to a shell without review and verification.
Do not upload broad directories, parent-directory paths, or sensitive files by habit.
Do not run social posting actions without explicit approval for the final text and account.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents use the infsh CLI to discover, run, monitor, and save results from inference.sh cloud apps.

faq.question: Do I need an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI requires login or an API key before it can run hosted apps.

faq.question: Can it generate images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include image, video, audio, LLM, search, 3D, and utility app examples.

faq.question: Will it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes, when a local path is used for an app input. Confirm paths before running any upload workflow.

faq.question: Can it post to Twitter or X?
faq.answer: The skill documents Twitter/X automation apps. Treat posting, direct messages, follows, likes, and retweets as sensitive actions.

faq.question: Is the install method risk free?
faq.answer: No. The quick install uses remote shell execution. Prefer verified manual installation with checksum and signature checks.
